_comment: Keyed by room_type. Formulas are fixed engineering math (unchanged by type) — only WHICH materials apply to a given room type varies here. These defaults are a reasonable starting point, not authoritative civil-engineering rules; adjust freely as real project experience informs them. `other` and any room_type not listed fall back to the full material set, since under-computing an unknown room is a worse failure mode than over-computing one.

_notes.bathroom/utility/store_room: Skip wall_paint_emulsion — walls in these spaces are typically tiled or left unfinished rather than painted, in common Indian residential practice. Plaster stays as the base layer under tile/finish.
_notes.balcony: Skip both wall_paint_emulsion and cement_plaster — balconies are frequently left exposed/unfinished on the parapet. Keeps flooring + structural (brick/concrete).
